title: Giant Ice Arena
content: I was in the mall world last night and went to a new place I had never been before. I started off at the place I call the university- I was with a group of people I didn’t know but they asked if I wanted to go catch a game. Not sure what they meant, I went with them to this giant ice arena. This place was absolutely massive! There were stands/bleachers wrapped around this massive ice rink as far as the eye could see. This place could probably fit 70k+ but the stands were mostly empty with groups of people scattered all around. There were 2 teams ready to play what looked identical to hockey but instead of regular hockey sticks, they were using sticks that looked like sticks meant for field hockey on the ice. I couldn’t make out if it was a puck or a ball. That’s about all I remember but I wanted to see if anyone has had a similar mall world experience.
